name: Hairline Header
description: A Geist-calibre site header: items land in reading order, a hairline and blur fade in on scroll, and one hover highlight stretches as it glides between links.

props.name: links
props.description: Centre links. Five read best on desktop.

props.name: activeIndex
props.description: Controlled current route: white text, a 4px dot (pops in on first view, then glides) and aria-current. Omit to let the header track clicks.

props.name: onNavigate
props.description: Called when a link is chosen.

props.name: searchLabel
props.description: Search chip text, shown from 1200px of container width.

props.name: onSearch
props.description: Fired by the chip and by ⌘K / Ctrl K anywhere on the page. Open your command palette here.

props.name: signIn
props.description: Quiet text link on the right.

props.name: condenseAt
props.description: Scroll distance in px before the hairline and blur appear and the bar condenses from 64 to 56px.

props.name: showSearch
props.description: Show the search chip (and the icon button on narrow bars). ⌘K / Ctrl K still calls onSearch.

props.name: scrollState
props.description: "auto" follows the page scroll. "top" and "scrolled" pin the resting or condensed look, handy for previews.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes on the header element.
